title: Forest Riddle
design_note: Chapter 4 turns English into navigation. The player learns a small set of nature and direction words because the forest literally requires them to move, look and choose a path. Written text appears only after sound + scene meaning are established.

scenes.title: Into the Forest
scenes.narrative: The blue owl message leads outside the academy. Milo points to a glowing tree and a small flower. The player hears the new words before seeing their written forms.
scenes.do: Associate tree and flower with the scene, then find the requested object without written labels.
scenes.help: Glow -> replay -> Milo points -> Spanish rescue.

scenes.title: The Sky Code
scenes.narrative: Three symbols carved into a stone show the sun, moon and star. The symbols light only when the player matches sound to image.
scenes.do: Hear each sky word, connect it to its symbol, then identify one from sound alone.
scenes.help: Symbol glow -> slow replay -> Spanish rescue.

scenes.title: Left or Right?
scenes.narrative: The path splits. A sign responds only to spoken direction clues. Choosing left or right changes the visible route.
scenes.do: Follow four spoken left/right commands by choosing the matching path.
scenes.help: Arrow animation -> slow replay -> Spanish rescue.

scenes.title: Look Up, Look Down
scenes.narrative: A star rune glows above while a flower glows below. Milo uses only look + direction to guide attention.
scenes.do: Move attention up or down and locate the matching clue.

scenes.title: Between Two Trees
scenes.narrative: The next rune is hidden between two trees. The player must place or find the star in the correct spatial relationship.
hear: The star is between the trees.
scenes.do: Place the star between two trees, then answer the location visually.

scenes.title: Walk the Path
scenes.narrative: The forest opens a stepping-stone path. Milo demonstrates walking, then the player follows short movement sequences.
scenes.do: Choose or execute the movement that matches each spoken command.

scenes.title: The Hidden Road
scenes.narrative: Leaves move before a hidden road appears. The wind becomes a narrative clue, and the useful word road becomes the player’s new target.
scenes.do: Connect wind to the moving leaves, then use a spoken direction clue to find the road.
scenes.help: Leaves move -> replay -> Milo points -> Spanish rescue.

scenes.title: The Forest Riddle
scenes.narrative: A stone speaks a four-line riddle. Each line is heard and acted out before the written English is revealed.
hear: Find the star between the trees.
scenes.do: Hear each line, choose the matching scene/action, then reveal the short written line.
scenes.help: Audio first -> visual action -> text reveal -> Spanish rescue.

scenes.title: Ask for the Road
scenes.narrative: A gentle forest guardian blocks the final path. The player has to ask a useful question and understand the answer.
scenes.do: Ask 'Where is the road?' by voice or guided fallback, then follow the spoken answer.
scenes.help: Model phrase -> chunk replay -> meaning hint -> Spanish rescue.

scenes.title: Finale: Find the Forest Exit
scenes.narrative: The exit only appears after one continuous spoken route. No new teaching occurs in the finale.
scenes.do: Complete a six-step route from sound and scene meaning, then ask one final navigation question.
scenes.help: Help remains available; full mastery bonus requires enough independent evidence across the chapter.
